title: Regular closed immersion of pure codimension
statement:
Let $k$ be a field, let $X$ be a separated
finite-type $k$-scheme and let $i:Z\hookrightarrow X$ be a
closed immersion with
$Z$ separated of finite type and *pure codimension* $c\in \mathbf Z_{\geq1}$ in the sense that for every $z\in Z$ the local ring
$\mathcal O_{X,z}$ has Krull dimension $\dim\mathcal O_{Z,z}+c$. The
immersion is *regular* if for every $z\in Z$ the ideal of $Z$ in
$\mathcal O_{X,z}$ is generated by a regular sequence of length $c$
(equivalently, by the *linearization lemma* below, a pair of smooth
schemes with a regular immersion is etale-locally the linear pair; in
the proofs below we use the linearization lemma).

lean.statement: def IsRegularImmersionOfPureCodimension {k : Type u} [Field k] {X Z : Scheme.{u}} (hX : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) (i : Z ⟶ X) [IsSeparated hX] [LocallyOfFiniteType hX] [QuasiCompact hX] [IsSeparated (i ≫ hX)] [LocallyOfFiniteType (i ≫ hX)] [QuasiCompact (i ≫ hX)] [IsClosedImmersion i] (c : ℕ) : Prop
lean.note: Previously unstated dependency. The upstream IsRegularImmersion is affine-local and does not record the chapter's prescribed stalkwise Krull-dimension equality. This module states the positive codimension and both stalkwise clauses, with the same separated finite-type field setting. The blueprint smooth-pair parenthesis is a forward theorem pointer, not additional defining data.
